{{Quote|Every one of these people could be a potential Jedi!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="DEII3" />}}
The '''Ysanna''' were a race of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who lived on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Descended from the [[Jedi survivors (Ossus)/Legends|survivors]] of the cataclysmic [[Cron Supernova/Legends|supernova]] caused by the destruction of the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], many of the Ysanna's ancestors were members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] studying at the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]]. Because of their ancestors' heritage and genetic make-up, the Ysanna as a people were Forceful and held many Jedi philosophies as their own. While primitive by galactic standards, the tribal people were fiercely loyal and protected the ruins of the Great Library, despite never venturing inside.

==History==
===Origins===
[[File:Ysanna-HBDE.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A trio of Ysanna.]]
Born from the [[Jedi survivors (Ossus)/Legends|survivors]] of the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova's]] effect on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]&mdash;a devastated planet with a caustic [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] full of [[Electrical storm/Legends|electrical storms]] and the danger of fierce predators&mdash;who had found protection in the vast subterranean<ref name="POTJ">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Crystal Caves (Ossus)/Legends|Crystal Caves]] under the [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountains]],<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> the Ysanna survived through sheer mettle and the luck bestowed to them by their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] bloodline. They eked out a simple existence as hunters and gatherers, while remaining aware of the ancient task bestowed upon them by their ancestors&mdash;to protect the secrets of the Jedi.

Following the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]], Jedi and other war refugees were led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] to establish a [[Jedi Colony|colony]] on Ossus. During their stay, they uncovered evidence suggesting the presence of survivors of the Cron supernova. Colonists reported missing items, strange sounds, and mysterious footprints, in areas deep within the surviving ruins. The Ysanna however, decided to remain unseen and undiscovered even as the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] discovered the colony and [[Invasion of Ossus|invaded]] the planet.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Survivors of the Cron Supernova}}</ref>

===Rejoining the galaxy===
Shortly after the return of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Kam Solusar]] arrived on Ossus in search of ancient Jedi artifacts. They soon came upon the Ysanna, who attempted to kill the two intruders. The fighting between the two groups came to a halt with the arrival of Imperial forces led by [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Sedriss QL]]. The Ysanna fought back, defeating most of the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark troopers]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], leaving Skywalker and Solusar to deal with only Sedriss and [[Vill Goir|another member]] of the [[Dark Side Elite]].

The battle had turned in favor of Skywalker and Solusar, when Sedriss took the young Ysanna [[Jem Ysanna|Jem]] hostage and backed against the inert [[Ood Bnar]], a tree-like [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] Jedi Master who had been dormant since the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|Battle of Ossus]]. Suddenly coming to life, Bnar attacked Sedriss and killed the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] along with himself.

[[Okko]], the tribe's chief and greatest shaman, allowed Skywalker to take Jem and her brother [[Rayf Ysanna|Rayf]] to train as Jedi, but was reluctant to introduce the rest of his people to the new Jedi teachings. However, the Ysanna would not remain isolated for much longer, as the Empire now knew of their whereabouts, and confrontation was brewing. Jem died on [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]], Rayf was killed on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], and Okko and two others were later trapped in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] by the forces of Palpatine, who was seeking to use the tribe as a means to halt the genetic decay of his last clone body.

At the same time Skywalker and Solusar explored Ossus, the Dark Jedi [[Travgen]] was hiding on the world after escaping the [[Great Jedi Purge]]. Travgen hid from the intruders, and thus escaped their notice. He had already enslaved several Ysanna tribes by this time. The fate of Travgen and his subjects is as yet unknown.<ref name="Corellia Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>

After the planet was opened to the general public, the world once again teemed with life. The Ysanna were now the hosts of a great number of archaeologists, historians, and all forms of academicians from all over the galaxy who studied, scrutinized, analyzed and discovered new things about Jedi and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] history.

==Society and culture==
[[File:YsannaNomadOnBeast.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Ysanna nomad on a riding beast.]]
Their Jedi heritage of knowledge and wisdom lost through generations of hardship and ignorance, the Ysanna degenerated into superstition. Their use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] diminished to nothing but simple tricks performed by unintelligible wizards, known to them as [[Ysanna magic]]. Their superstition built upon the remaining Jedi and Sith artifacts left on the world from its speedy evacuation. The Ysanna wizards used various Sith masks in battle to intimidate their enemies, and when protecting the Jedi ruins from trespassers, graverobbers, tomb raiders, or anybody that would walk on their sacred ground. They had a polytheistic religion.

Despite their drastically lessened knowledge of the Force, the Ysanna managed to preserve some Force techniques that were lost to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] over the millennia, including the ability to form [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghosts]]. They also perfected the [[Telekinesis/Legends|Projectile guidance]] technique.

[[File:YsannaProf3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ysanna tribesman firing Force guided projectiles.]]
Armed with unique [[Concussion bow/Legends|Concussion bow]] [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]], the Ysanna tribespeople perfected a technique of guiding a bullet's trajectory in midair. This made the Ysanna incredible marksmen, capable of firing at a target, then "guiding" the bullet to hit the target as it moved. While not a particularly taxing ability, as Ysanna were seen plenty of times firing whole magazines of ammunition out of their rifles while guiding the bullets through the Force, it did however require concentration. A Ysanna that was not imminently being attacked, for instance, could direct and control a multitude of bullets in quick succession, or even multiple bullets at once. The closer the Ysanna was to an enemy however, and the more he had to divert his attention from the bullet, to the attacks of his enemy, the fewer bullets he would be able to control.

==Behind the scenes==
The Ysanna first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book series]] ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]'', released between [[1994]] and [[1995]].<ref name="DEII3" /> While multiple sources state that the Ysanna were [[near-Human]]<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref><ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> or [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]],<ref name="NoP" /> several other sources state that Ysanna were a tribe of [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="DB Jem">{{DB|character|jemysanna|Ysanna, Jem}}</ref><ref name="SWCC">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref><ref name="EGttF" /><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="FaD CR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

They were set to appear in the [[2018]] update "Jedi Under Siege" for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'', gaining a codex entry, but were eventually left out.<ref name="TORCUT">{{WebCite|url=https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/cdx/the-ysanna|text=Unfinished codex entry within the game files.|archivedate=20210517125647}}</ref> However, they are indirectly mentioned during gameplay.<ref name="TOR" />
